teaser: Onboarding by interview: Claude asks what you want and which sites you like, material comes any way, and you end up editing with Claude.
core_idea: Onboarding should start with an interview by Claude that produces a brief, accept material in any form, base the five designs on sites the person likes, and end at the milestone of the owner editing their own site with Claude.

nodes.label: The brief
nodes.summary: One page, corrected by the person.

quotes.text: Most people do not know what they want from a website until someone asks them the right questions.
People find it hard to describe a design, and easy to point at one.
the hand-over is not the end of onboarding, it is the middle
